geometries.method: Editorial Ligurian Sea point in the source region of the Northern Current; not a measured core or the full Northern Current path.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: The source describes a Northern Current formed in the Ligurian Sea that flows onward along the Provençal and Balearic slopes; the Ligurian name is treated here as its source-region segment, without assigning the whole system's extent to this record.

relations.interpretation: OSW classification of a source-described regional segment; no path or length equivalence is inferred
